summary: On his Kick stream on November 13, 2026, Adin Ross unboxed an early copy of GTA 6 that he said cost him $10,000, six days before the game unlocks on November 19. page_text:
Adin Ross opens his $10,000 early GTA 6 copy on stream: no disc, and the code on camera
On his Kick stream on November 13, 2026, Adin Ross unboxed an early copy of GTA 6 that he said cost him $10,000, six days before the game unlocks on November 19. There was no disc inside the case, only a download code, and the code was visible on camera. Clips of the moment went viral on X the same day.

The timeline
2026-11-13  Adin Ross unboxes an early GTA 6 copy on his Kick stream
He said the copy cost him $10,000. The game unlocks on November 19, six days later. [hypefresh.com]
2026-11-13  No disc inside the case
The case held no disc, only a download code, per HypeFresh. [hypefresh.com]
2026-11-13  The code shows on camera
Viral clips posted on X say he leaked the code on stream; @Dirk_mp4's clip has over 19,000 likes. [x.com/Dirk_mp4]
